decision.justification: The series has strong trend and seasonality but a spectrum close to white noise, unstable model rankings (Kendall tau -0.099), and highly correlated errors (mean 0.912, only 1 independent group). The median on a pruned 6-model pool (pool4) is a robust combination that avoids overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows while retaining complementary signal from ETS (trend), NaiveSeasonal (seasonality), and the catboost variants. The leader's margin over the runner-up is indistinguishable, and the diagnosis explicitly warns that fitted weights would overfit this near-noise series. Accepting the robust median on the de-redundantized pool is the safest and most principled choice.
